column8: return_option=since_inception) and cross-checked day by day against the publisher's own dashboard copy (https://wholesale.banking.societegenerale.com/fileadmin/indices_feeds/ti_screen/data/4.nav.csv)
column9: which agrees on every common daily return to within 2 bp. The calendar years were reconciled against six independent publications of them
